incident-bot: ALERT: billing-metering emitter lag detected — EU region delayed emits > 15m, 12 accounts flagged with overage notifications. paging oncall.
oncall-alex: ack — looking. assigning to @sre-maya. any immediate customer-facing impact known?
sre-maya: I'm seeing emitter consumer lag on kafka (emitter-consumer-group) and spike in commit latency. offsets stuck at partitions 5-8. running quick checks now.
billing-ops: shadow vs primary counts diverging for window 2026-03-14T02:00Z — ~18% fewer tokens emitted to ledger than expected. overage flags sent out via alerts queue.
eng-ops: possible culprit: emitter pod OOMs during recent config deploy. logs show GC spikes + repeated retries. can do a controlled restart of deploy/metering-emitter.
oncall-alex: please follow runbook: /runbooks/metering/emitter-lag.md and post commands you run.
sre-maya: checking consumer group: ```kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group emitter-consumer-group --bootstrap-server kafka-eu:9092``` shows LAG 128k messages on those partitions. also seeing errors: "Timeout while fetching metadata" intermittently.
eng-ops: I'll scale emitter replicas from 3 -> 5 and restart one at a time. cmd: `kubectl scale deploy/metering-emitter -n billing-prod --replicas=5` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/metering-emitter -n billing-prod`.
sre-maya: doing controlled restart on one replica now. monitoring offsets.
incident-bot: system: restart job started by eng-ops at 1753141640.
sre-maya: first pod restarted, consumer rebalanced, lag dropped from 128k -> 42k. continuing restarts.
billing-ops: receiving partial catchup metrics — ledger ingest rate back to ~80% of baseline. but window 02:00Z still undercounted relative to expected.
support-jordan: support queue: customers receiving overage emails are small number of mid-market accounts. drafting triage note for them. need list of impacted org IDs.
billing-ops: impacted org IDs: acct-1023, acct-2044, acct-3351, acct-4420 (internal list). overage flags were sent at 02:18Z due to emit delay.
product-liaison: will coordinate customer comms. short note: "We experienced a temporary billing telemetry delay affecting some usage visibility and alerts. No changes to customer usage or charges — we're reconciling counts now and will reverse any erroneous overage notifications." ok?
support-jordan: good. will send that to top 4 and include a screenshot of current reconciliation status.
sre-maya: after full rollout, lag -> 0 for all partitions. final catchup completed at 1753141805 (~28m from alert). backfill job queued to replay missed emits into ledger: `python scripts/backfill_emits.py --from-ts 2026-03-14T01:45Z --to-ts 2026-03-14T02:30Z --target ledger`.
eng-ops: backfill scheduled on low-traffic window, rate-limited to avoid overload. monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/metering/emitter-eu
billing-ops: estimate: ~12k tokens missing from ledger per impacted org on that window; nightly reconciliation will confirm exact deltas. we'll also cancel erroneous overage emails once counts updated.
oncall-alex: thanks. immediate mitigations done. who's taking the post-incident follow-up and customer rollbacks?
billing-ops: owning reconciliation and rollback of overage flags. ETA for final reconciliation: tonight 03:30Z. will update ticket #BILL-4678.
support-jordan: I'll send provisional customer notes now and follow up after reconciliation.
product-liaison: please CC me on outbound messages to top customers.
oncall-alex: handing off to oncall-lee for overnight monitoring. oncall-lee, please take watch and escalate if backfill rate or ledger errors > 1%.
oncall-lee: taking it. ping me @oncall-lee if anything spikes.
incident-bot: INCIDENT INVESTIGATION LOG appended: root cause suspected: emitter pod resource pressure after config push -> consumer rebalance failures -> kafka lag -> delayed emits -> overage alert triggers. action items: 1) backfill missed emits (billing-ops) 2) add healthcheck and auto-restart guard on emitter (eng-ops) 3) improve alerting to suppress overage emails until reconciliation (product + billing) 4) postmortem draft (sre-maya) due EOD tomorrow.
sre-maya: opened postmortem draft at https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/BILL-1753141593-draft
billing-ops: creating follow-up run to revoke overage emails and publish reconciliation findings.
support-jordan: sending customer updates now.
oncall-lee: monitoring and standing by. all clear for now but will watch for regressions."
